name: DomainSubRegion - Default (seed v1)
description: An extra WorldGuard region of a town, district, structure or gate (KNG-254). Opened from the domain's Sub-regions step, with the domain already filled in.

steps.description: Draw the extra region in game. It is renamed domain_<domain id>_sub_<id> when saved and becomes a copy of the domain's main region (flags, owners, members, priority).

fields.label: Domain
fields.description: The domain this region belongs to. A sub-region can't move to another domain: remove it and add a new one there.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Optional label shown in the web app and the server log, e.g. 'Tower' or 'House' (at most 64 characters).

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Use Send to Minecraft and select the area with WorldEdit: //sel cuboid, //sel poly, or //sel cyl for a round tower (stored as a polygon along the circle). Type 'select <region>' in game to adopt an existing region instead; it is renamed too. Must be in the domain's world and used by no other domain.
